description: This file declares the SubstitutionWriter class and related functions for handling string and file path substitutions in build scripts, specifically for source, target, compiler, and linker outputs within a build system.

classes.name: SubstitutionWriter
classes.description: A class providing static methods to write and apply substitution patterns to strings and files in a build system, supporting source, target, compiler, and linker substitutions.

methods.name: WriteWithNinjaVariables
methods.description: Writes a substitution pattern to an output stream with Ninja variables.

methods.name: GetListAsSourceFiles
methods.description: Converts a SubstitutionList to a list of SourceFiles assuming no substitutions.

methods.name: GetListAsOutputFiles
methods.description: Converts a SubstitutionList to a list of OutputFiles based on settings.

methods.name: ApplyPatternToSource
methods.description: Applies a substitution pattern to a source file, returning a SourceFile.

methods.name: ApplyPatternToSourceAsString
methods.description: Applies a substitution pattern to a source file, returning a string.

methods.name: ApplyPatternToSourceAsOutputFile
methods.description: Applies a substitution pattern to a source file, returning an OutputFile.

methods.name: ApplyListToSource
methods.description: Applies a substitution list to a source file, appending results to output.

methods.name: ApplyListToSourceAsString
methods.description: Applies a substitution list to a source file, outputting strings.

methods.name: ApplyListToSourceAsOutputFile
methods.description: Applies a substitution list to a source file, outputting OutputFiles.

methods.name: WriteNinjaVariablesForSource
methods.description: Writes Ninja variable definitions for a source file based on substitution types.

methods.name: GetSourceSubstitution
methods.description: Extracts a specific substitution from a source file, relative to a directory if specified.

methods.name: ApplyPatternToTargetAsOutputFile
methods.description: Applies a pattern to a target and tool, returning an OutputFile.

methods.name: ApplyListToTargetAsOutputFile
methods.description: Applies a substitution list to a target and tool, outputting OutputFiles.

methods.name: GetTargetSubstitution
methods.description: Retrieves a substitution string for a target and type, with failure handling.

methods.name: GetTargetSubstitution
methods.description: Retrieves a substitution string for a target and type.

methods.name: ApplyPatternToCompilerAsOutputFile
methods.description: Applies a pattern to a target and source, returning an OutputFile for compiler output.

methods.name: ApplyListToCompilerAsOutputFile
methods.description: Applies a substitution list to a target and source, outputting OutputFiles for compiler.

methods.name: GetCompilerSubstitution
methods.description: Gets a string substitution for compiler based on target and source.

methods.name: ApplyPatternToLinkerAsOutputFile
methods.description: Applies a pattern to a target and tool, returning an OutputFile for linker output.

methods.name: ApplyListToLinkerAsOutputFile
methods.description: Applies a substitution list to a target and tool, outputting OutputFiles for linker.

methods.name: GetLinkerSubstitution
methods.description: Gets a string substitution for linker based on target and tool.
